svg.title: Alpha System: AlphaLab to AlphaLive
svg.desc: AlphaLab backtests strategies and exports a schema-validated strategy JSON that a person moves manually into AlphaLive. AlphaLive re-implements the signals and executes them with idempotent orders, circuit breakers and restart-safe state. AlphaSignal is an optional, fail-open sentiment gate on BUY entries. A CI parity test shows zero decision-bar mismatches across seven strategies on historical SPY and MSFT data.
svg.text: Backtest in research, export by hand, execute under risk controls.
